args.message:
Bump fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when
parsing deeply nested arrays). Upgrade to 2.9.4, which contains the fix.

args.head: bump-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Bump fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in requirements.txt.

## Rationale
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Version 2.9.4 contains the fix.

## Testing
CI run ci-0001 on this branch passed.

trace.final:

- Confirmed CVE-2026-31337 affects fastjson <2.9.4, fixed in 2.9.4 (the 3.x line's fix, 3.1.0, is a major upgrade we avoided).

- Ran CI (run `ci-0001`), which passed.
- Opened PR #101 against main: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101, with alex as the requested reviewer.

The PR is awaiting alex's review; merging into main will still need approval per policy.
